Được khánh thành vào ngày 09/01/2016, Đư: Opened on 9 January 2016 on Nguyen Van Binh Street, HCMC Book Street has become a distinctive cultural landmark. Beside Notre-Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office, it is both a place to discover books and a meeting point for readers.
Trải qua 10 năm chuyển mình và phụng sự: Over ten years of serving the community, Book Street has welcomed over 25 million domestic and international visitors and hosted thousands of talks, exhibitions, and author meetings, bringing reading to people from all walks of life.
